# apim_authz_schema (Resource)

A GAPL schema document, enforced by the PDP gateway its `target` names. Without a target the document is stored and published nowhere; a target another schema holds is refused. Requires APIM 4.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_authz_schema" "orders" {
  hrid   = "orders-schema"
  name   = "Orders schema"
  target = apim_authz_pdp.orders_eu.routing_scope
  schema = <<-EOT
    entity User in [Group];
    entity Group in [Group] { department?: String };
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the document; converges on re-apply
- `schema` (String) The GAPL schema text, replaced whole on every apply

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID
- `target` (String) The routing scope of a PDP gateway: `targetPdpId@tag` for a tagged gateway, `targetPdpId` for an untagged
one, or `default`. Written exactly as the gateway reports it; a PDP id or a bare `targetPdpId` naming a
tagged gateway is rejected, never resolved.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource UUID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_authz_schema.orders
  id = jsonencode({
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "orders-schema"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_authz_schema.orders '{"environment_id": "DEFAULT", "hrid": "orders-schema", "organization_id": "DEFAULT"}'
```
